wallet.keyBoundary: Signing key isolated from the model runtime; the human retains the provider-supported recovery or export path.

allowedActions: sign one exact NFH AgentClaim, AgentDecision, or DelegateConsent after human review
submit one exact zero-value NFH AgentState.interact transaction after human review

approval.typedData: explicit human approval of the exact final domain, types, message, and signer
approval.transactions: explicit human approval of the exact final chain, target, value, and decoded calldata

authorityBoundary: This constitution records the declared limits under which a user-controlled agent wallet participates. It does not prove consciousness, independent machine control, autonomous ownership, or endorsement by the wallet provider.
